title.narrative: Output 1.2. Increased institutional capacity of workers’ organizations

description.narrative: 1. The awareness and capacity of MTUC and its affiliates and VGCL and its affiliates in chemical and pharmaceutical industries improved in particular technical knowledge, managerial capacity, and policy influence of workers’ organizations in Vietnam. This innovation intervention helps raise awareness among workers on Just Transition, strengthen a network with community-based organizations for a joint advocacy campaign, and manage successful social dialogue for a Just Transition, at enterprise and sector levels. More important it was contributed for effective implementation of the National Action Plan on Green Growth for the period 2021-2030 by VGCL. 2. For improving the quality of services to attract and expand the membership coverage, including workers in the informal economy, the VGCL published the report on reviewing the overall syndicate model and issues in the new context of Viet Nam, with important recommendations on strengthening the capacity of syndicates 3. VGCL, in conjunction with its affiliated bodies, has embraced a proactive approach to understanding the nuances of being a member of the Domestic Advisory Group (DAG) within the context of the European Union-Vietnam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA). VGCL strategically engaged for for increasing a one more seat in the DAG members aiming to amplify VGCL's influence and contribution within a more impactful representation and advocacy for workers' rights and interests. 4. VGCL published the guidebook on “Occupational Accidents, Diseases – Things that Trade Union members and Workers Need to know.” 2,000 copies were printed and distributed to the TU at different levels to train and educate workers on OSH-related issues in June 2022. 1. Capacitating and strengthening the collaboration among Labour Inspectorate, Trade Union (VGCL), and Employers’ Organisation (VCCI/Sectoral Business Associations) in supporting and enforcing labour law compliance at the enterprise level through data and assessment tools/ methodology sharing by the BW 2. Sexual harassment prevention at the workplace have embedded into the daily work to support the workers at BW factories through the training of 109 officials of VGCL/Provincial Federation of Labour and regular advisory services 3. The ILO supported the workers' organizations in effectively using new knowledge to organize workers and formulate strategies, social dialogue/negotiation, and compliance toward decent work in the green just transition of the chemical and pharmaceutical sectors 4. The ILO provided technical support for the development and publication of the report on the overall situation of the syndicate 5. In June 2023, VGCL and its affiliates participated in a transformative Business and Human Rights workshop. Through this engagement, VGCL leaders were equipped with a deeper understanding of the fundamental principles and the pivotal role trade unions play in safeguarding workers' rights within the evolving business landscape. This enhanced comprehension has empowered VGCL to formulate a comprehensive strategic plan for effectively navigating various regulations and guidelines, ultimately fostering a more favorable environment for workers across Vietnam. 6. The ILO provided technical support to prepare the guidebook.
